authority: Original PR #1 alpha-first continuation. Terminal wealth and cross-scope alpha remain the discovery priority; MDD/orders/turnover remain recorded diagnostics.

failed_predecessor.finding: The first-close capital-full displacement improves common-five but changes union/removal paths too early. A nominal nondeployable vacancy alone is insufficient evidence to sell an incumbent.

root_cause: The settled-reference-rearm account can repeatedly request a second-slot vacancy fill with observed cash below the unchanged 1%-NAV ordinary-order floor while one incumbent holds almost all capital. Because candidate1 only considers displacement when vacancy == 0, actual execution failure leaves the weak incumbent protected indefinitely. The predecessor showed that preemptively treating the first such close as capital-full is too eager.
economic_hypothesis: Use actual inventory feedback as the confirmation. Let the unchanged settled-reference owner make the first nominal vacancy-fill request. If on the immediately following trading session the requested vacancy still did not create an additional actual holding, observed cash remains below the unchanged 1%-NAV ordinary-order materiality, and a held incumbent has decayed below its own admission reference while a currently eligible challenger exceeds that reference, then the vacancy is execution-confirmed dead capital. Sell only that incumbent to release capital; never buy from forecast sale proceeds.

treatment.base: Reuse offensive_settled_reference_rearm semantics exactly for acute invalidation, settlement-aware reference rearm, trend-edge fallback, exits and ordinary candidate1 ownership.
treatment.confirmation: Record a close only when the unchanged owner requests an ordinary vacancy fill while actual held count is below Config.max_positions and observed cash is below 0.01 * observed NAV. On the next trading session, confirmation exists only if actual held count did not increase. This is fill feedback, not a tunable waiting period.
treatment.confirmed_displacement: With a confirmed failed vacancy, current cash still below 0.01 * NAV and market trend open, apply the exact campaign-reference displacement predicate: weakest held incumbent with current score below finite owned admission reference; strongest ordinary eligible unheld challenger with score above that same reference. Request sale of only the incumbent. No same-close challenger purchase.
treatment.successful_or_stale_attempt: If prior vacancy fill produced an additional actual holding, or the previous close did not contain a qualifying nondeployable vacancy-fill request, do not use this mechanism. Continue exact settled-reference-rearm behavior.
treatment.execution: Unchanged cash-only long-only close decision / next-session execution, T+1, sells before buys, prior-volume capacity, board lots, the original 1%-NAV ordinary-order materiality, fees, slippage and price limits.

structural_difference: Not the rejected deployable-vacancy predecessor: this candidate requires observed failed execution before displacement and therefore does not act on the first nondeployable-vacancy close.
Not opportunity_reassignment: no scheduled review, mature-hold age or 1.25 score multiplier; it acts only after an actual failed vacancy fill.
Not joint_funding/allocation auction: no sizing/resource-sharing geometry changes and no sale proceeds are allocated before settlement.
Not generic reentry/risk control: no waiting-day count, shock breadth, exposure cap or price recovery gate is added.

measurement.primary_objective: maximize mean(log(terminal wealth)) across the three fixed scopes
measurement.secondary_objective: maximize minimum terminal wealth across the same scopes
measurement.promotion_rule: Must improve the alpha objective versus the current settled-reference-rearm leader, not merely baseline control, before hosted full-history expansion.
measurement.failure_rule: If it fails, preserve exact evidence and do not search confirmation counts, materiality percentages, score margins, review cadences, position counts or rearm thresholds.

prohibitions: No neighboring parameter search or winner splicing
